arguments.text: Fixed. In `middleware/proxy.go` the balancers indexed an empty target list: `randomBalancer.Next` panicked with "invalid argument to Intn" and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` panicked with a divide-by-zero (both when a balancer has no targets, e.g. `NewRandomBalancer(nil)`). Both `Next` methods now return `nil` for an empty target list, and `ProxyWithConfig` returns `echo.ErrServiceUnavailable` (503) when no target is available, so a request is answered instead of crashing the server. `go test ./...` passes, including all pre-existing proxy tests.

arguments.text: Done — I had not yet made any edit for request #4, so `bind.go` is untouched (verified with `git status`: only `context.go` and `middleware/proxy.go` are modified). Nothing to undo.

Fixed in `context.go`. `Context#Scheme()` returned the raw value of any `X-Forwarded-Proto` / `X-Forwarded-Protocol` / `X-Url-Scheme` header, so a bogus value (e.g. `invalid`) was reported as the scheme. Now each header is only used when it actually holds a valid HTTP scheme (`http`/`https`, case-insensitive); otherwise the check falls through to the next header and finally to `http`. `go test ./...` passes, including the pre-existing `TestContext_Scheme`.

package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
)

func TestZZGzipEmptyVariants(t *testing.T) {
	cases := map[string]echo.HandlerFunc{
		"string-empty": func(c echo.Context) error { return c.String(http.StatusOK, "") },
		"write-empty":  func(c echo.Context) error { _, err := c.Response().Write([]byte{}); return err },
		"no-content":   func(c echo.Context) error { return c.NoContent(http.StatusOK) },
		"nil":          func(c echo.Context) error { return nil },
	}
	for name, h := range cases {
		e := echo.New()
		e.Use(Gzip())
		e.GET("/", h)
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
		req.Header.Set(echo.HeaderAcceptEncoding, gzipScheme)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		t.Logf("%-14s code=%d ce=%q ct=%q bodylen=%d body=%q", name, rec.Code, rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentEncoding), rec.Header().Get(echo.HeaderContentType), len(rec.Body.Bytes()), rec.Body.String())
	}
}
EOF
